note: Roles beyond the bilingual starter (primary/fallback terms, names, kanji). One frozen catalogue title per role, chosen once for every learner language: the target language does not change with the learner's, so a monolingual, grammar, frequency, pitch or example title is the same recommendation for all 32. Priorities continue the starter's 10/20/30.

slots.note: 新明解国語辞典 第八版 — the smallest of the mainstream monolingual desk dictionaries, so the first Japanese-in-Japanese step is a 10 MB download rather than 83 MB.
Dictionary of Japanese Grammar (consolidated) — the reference grammar entry point; bilingual, so machine translation can carry it into a learner language that has no native grammar dictionary.
JPDB v2.2 kana frequency — matches the curated Japanese frequency default and orders lookups from the first install.
NHK日本語発音アクセント新辞典 — the reference pitch-accent dictionary; 2 MB, so pitch is on by default.
用例.jp — the catalogue's only sentence-example collection for Japanese headwords.
